question: jozabad-5 is recorded with more than one father: jeshua-3, jeshua-5.

actions.why: The Hebrew names Jozabad son of Jeshua among the Levites; it does not identify his father as the priest Jeshua son of Jozadak. This unsupported identification creates a second father alongside the owner's protected ruling.
The Hebrew explicitly identifies the altar-building priest Jeshua as son of Jozadak. That person is jeshua-3; the row incorrectly targets jeshua-5.

note: Preserve the owner's row 105929. Ezra 8:33 names Jozabad's father as Jeshua but does not independently establish that he is the Jeshua of Ezra 2:40.
